Exams » OSSSC Medical Lab Technician Recruitment 2026... The Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC) has released the OSSSC Medical Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 Notification for 380 Medical Laboratory Technician vacancies. The online application process has started on 17 November 2026 at the official website, osssc.gov.in. Interested and eligible candidates can complete their registration or re-registration by 10 December 2026 , while the last date to submit the online application form is 17 December 2026 . Interested candidates should check the eligibility criteria, age limit, application fee, selection process, and other important details before applying. OSSSC Laboratory Technician Notification 2026 Out The OSSSC has released the official notification for the recruitment of 380 Medical Laboratory Technicians under the district cadre. The notification includes details regarding vacancies, educational qualifications, age limit, application fee, selection process, and examination pattern. Interested candidates can download the official notification PDF from the OSSSC website at osssc.gov.in and check all the recruitment-related instructions before applying online. Particulars Details Recruiting Organization Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC) Post Name Medical Laboratory Technician Total Vacancies 380 Job Category Government Job (District Cadre, Group-C) Job Location Odisha (13 District Establishments under Health & Family Welfare Dept.) Application Mode Online (via osssc.gov.in ) Registration Start Date 17 November 2026 Last Date to Register 10 December 2026 Last Date to Apply 17 December 2026 Selection Process Written Examination (100 marks, MCQ) + Document Verification Salary ₹25,500 – ₹81,100 (Pay Matrix Level-7, Cell-01) Official Website osssc.gov.in Important Dates The OSSSC has announced the registration and application dates along with its recruitment notification. Registration alone does not complete the application process. OSSSC Medical Lab Technician Vacancy 2026 The OSSSC has announced a total of 380 vacancies for the post of Medical Laboratory Technician. These vacancies are available under the district cadre, and candidates will be required to provide their preferred districts while submitting the application form. The final district allocation will be made on the basis of merit, candidate preferences, and vacancy availability. OSSSC Laboratory Technician Eligibility Criteria 2026 Candidates interested in applying for the OSSSC Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification, age limit, and other eligibility requirements prescribed by the commission. Educational Qualification Candidates must possess the following educational qualifications: Must have passed +2 Science from the Council of Higher Secondary Education (CHSE), Odisha, or an equivalent recognised board. Must have completed a Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (DMLT) or Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) from a Government Medical College and Hospital or a recognised private institution/AICTE-approved institution, as applicable under the notification. Must possess a valid registration or renewal certificate issued by the Laboratory Technician Council in Odisha on the date of application. Candidates must be able to read, write, and speak the Odia language. Odia Language Requirement Candidates must fulfil at least one of the prescribed Odia language conditions: Passed Odia as a language subject in the Middle School examination. Passed Odia as a language subject in the Matriculation examination. Passed the prescribed Odia language test conducted by the Government. Fulfilled the other equivalent educational conditions mentioned in the official notification. Age Limit The minimum age required to apply for the OSSSC Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026 is 21 years, while the maximum age limit is 42 years. The application process started on 17 November 2026 , and candidates must complete their registration by 10 December 2026 . The last date to submit the online application form is 17 December 2026 . Applicants should fill in their personal and educational details carefully, upload the required documents, select their preferred three districts, and submit the application form before the deadline. Steps to Apply Online for OSSSC Medical Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 Candidates can follow the steps given below to complete the OSSSC Laboratory Technician online application process: Visit the official website of OSSSC at ossc.gov.in. Click on the Registration link available on the homepage. Complete the registration process by entering the required details. Log in using your registration number and password. Open the Medical Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026 application form. Enter your personal, educational, and other required details. Upload your photograph, signature, and necessary documents. Select your three preferred districts for posting. Pay the applicable application fee through the available online payment methods. Review all the details carefully and submit the application form. Download and print the final application form for future reference. Selection Process 2026 The selection process for OSSSC Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026 consists of the following stages: Written Examination: An objective-type exam of 100 marks with a duration of 2 hours. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates (up to 1.25 times the vacancies, category-wise) will be called for document verification. District Allocation: Candidates will be allotted districts based on merit, preferences, and vacancy availability. physically for Counselling/ District Allocation as per the vacancies advertised for

selected.

website shall remain for a specific period only. Therefore, the candidates are
advised to download the uploaded information and keep it with them for the future.

under the Right to Information Act, 2005 shall be entertained nor will information
be provided.

manipulation by the candidate in the online application/ Admission Letter/
Intimation Letter and detection of use of unfair means (Physical/ Digital) during

liable to be disqualified or debarred from the examination as well as future

imposed with any other penalty/ punishment as per Acts/ Rules of

Terms and conditions of contract are as given under-
i. Eligibility Qualification & Experience:

(i) Post Graduate degree in Chemistry preferably specialized in organic
chemistry from any recognized university/institute.
(ii) With one years’ research experience in Organic chemistry

ii. Tenure: Young Professional will be engaged for a fixed period of one year but not
exceeding 3 years for providing high quality services on specific projects as per
requirement of the concerned division.

iii, Remuneration: A consolidated amount of Rs. 40,000/- per month shall be paid.

In case, the contract is for more than one year, the remuneration shall be
reviewed after completion of one year Total enhancement of remuneration shall not
exceed 5% annually in any case. The enhancement in remuneration will be based on
his/her performance during the year after recommendation of NSI, Kanpur which shall

iv. Allowances: No TA/DA shall be admissible for joining the assignment or on its
completion. No other facilities such as DA, accommodation, residential phone/
conveyance/transport, foreign travel, personal staff, medical reimbursement, CGHS etc.
would be admissible to the Young Professionals.

v. Leave: Young Professional shall be eligible for 8 days casual leave for a completed
period of / year on pro-rata basis. No remuneration for the period of absence in excess
of the admissible leave will be paid to Young Professional. Un-availed leave shall
neither be carried forward to next year nor encashed

vii. Tax deduction at source (TDS): TDS as applicable under the rules shall be
deducted from the monthly remuneration. A TDS certificate shall be issued by the
concerned DDO on demand.

vii. Termination of Engagement: The services of the Young Professional can be laid
off after giving one month's notice. However, the department reserves the rights to
terminate the contract at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason
for it. The individual Young Professional can also seek for termination of the contract
upon giving one month's notice to the Department
